create_ArrowExtensionArray: create an ArrowExtensionArray backed by a PyArrow ChunkedArray from scalar sequences or pyarrow arrays
test_ArrowExtensionArray_getitem: test the ArrowExtensionArray __getitem__ method for integer, slice, and boolean array indexing
build_ArrowExtensionArray_from_sequence: build an ArrowExtensionArray from a sequence of scalars with a specified pyarrow dtype
test_ArrowExtensionArray_arithmetic: test the ArrowExtensionArray arithmetic methods for add, sub, mul, truediv, floordiv, and pow operations
summarize_ArrowExtensionArray_reduce: summarize the ArrowExtensionArray _reduce method for any, all, min, max, sum, mean, median, prod, std, var, sem, kurt, and skew
